decisions.label: Yes
decisions.description: The affirmative response to a question.

verification.note: NCIT:C49488 Yes; standard NCIT affirmative qualifier.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: No
decisions.description: The non-affirmative response to a question.

verification.note: NCIT:C49487 No; standard NCIT negative qualifier, paired with NCIT:C49488 Yes.

decisions.label: Clinical Trial Censoring
decisions.description: When information on time-to-event is not available due to loss to follow-up or non-occurrence of outcome event before the trial end.

verification.note: NCIT:C118962 Clinical Trial Censoring; label differs ('Clinical Trial Censoring' vs 'Censored') but correctly describes the censoring concept in survival analysis — individuals for whom the recurrence event was not observed during the study period. Review recommended.
